title: RNA Sequencing of LT-HSCs and ST-HSCs from healthy adult human Bone Marrow
description: The transcriptome of LT-HSC (CD34+CD38-CD45RA+CD90+CD49f+) and ST-HSC (CD34+CD38-CD45RA+CD90-CD49f-) from healthy adult human Bone Marrow Cells were assessed by RNA-seq.

samples.title: Lonza_0000669433_LT_HSCs
samples.description: Protocols: CD34+ BM cells from Lonza were stained with CD34(APCCy7), CD38(PECy7), CD90(BV605), CD45RA(BV421) and CD49f (PECy5) and Live/Dead(Zombie). Two population were sorted the LT-HSC(CD34+CD38-CD90+CD45RA-Cd49f+) and the ST-HSCs(CD34+CD38-CD90-CD45RA-Cd49f-). Sort was performed on FACS Aria III (Becton Dickinson) at the MPI FACS facility, Freiburg, Germany. The following sort parameters were used: 100 um nozzle with approximately10,000 evt/s. Sorted cells were collected into ice-cold RNA lysis buffer (ARCTURUS PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit (Life Technologies, Invitrogen)) and stored at -80C until further usage. Total RNA isolation was performed from the indicated populations using ARCTURUS PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit (Life Technologies, Invitrogen) according to the manufacturers instructions. DNAse treatment was performed using RNAse-free DNAse Set (Qiagen). Total RNA was used as starting material for cDNA-libraries preparation using the SMARTseq v4 Ultra Low RNA Kit (Takara) according to the manufacturers indications. Sequencing libraries were prepared from 10ng of cDNA libraries as input using NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA library prep kit (#E7805S, NEB) according to manufacturer’s protocol together with unique dual indexing barcodes (NEB, #E6440). Libraries were amplified with 7 PCR-cycles before Ampure bead (Beckman-Coultier) clean-up and subsequent quality control.
